hud.label: SORRY SAID TONIGHT
hud.sub: ONE TO HIM · ONE TO ALLAH

captions: 5:40 p.m. Floodlights. He's eight. His first real match.
He misses an easy pass. You shout his name. Loud.
The whole bench turns around. He stares at the grass.
In the car he whispers: “Sorry, Dad.” He's the one saying sorry.
9:10 p.m. He's asleep. Stars on the ceiling.
You tuck his blanket in. You whisper: “I'm sorry.”
Then, by his bed: “Astaghfirullah. Make me gentle, Ya Allah.”
Tomorrow you may slip again. And again, you'll turn back.

post.caption:
